name: VQAv2
description: VQAv2 is a balanced Visual Question Answering dataset that addresses language bias by providing complementary images for each question, forcing models to rely on visual understanding rather than language priors. It contains approximately twice the number of image-question pairs compared to the original VQA dataset.
typical_sota_score: ~82–86% (frontier multimodal models as of 2025; benchmark is largely saturated at the top)
reputation: Standard visual QA benchmark used broadly to evaluate vision-language models; introduced at CVPR 2017; widely used on leaderboards such as Papers With Code
notes: Introduced at CVPR 2017. Balanced by constructing complementary image pairs so that each question is asked about two different images with opposite answers, mitigating language bias. Split into train (~443K), validation (~214K), and test (~448K) question-answer pairs. VQA v2.0 is based on 123,287 MS COCO images.
